tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Call this first. Returns the account, the person's role, its stores and readiness: whether orders can be paid now and, if not, nextSteps, each with the website link that fixes it. Call it again after the person has done a step.

tools.name: list_garments
tools.description: What you can print on (GD64, CC17, …), with their color codes and names, sizes, print areas in inches and artwork rules. code gives just one.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: The price list in cents: one shirt per garment and size, one- or two-sided, plus one flat shipping fee per order. Ships to the 50 US states and DC only. For a total, don't add it up yourself: use create_estimate or create_order.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Orders, newest first (limit 1 gives the latest), each with its status and a plain-words progress note. get_order has the lines, tracking and payment.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: One order, by its id or its number (#1042): its lines, quote (quoteId and totalCents), status and hold reason, packages and tracking, the latest payment attempt and its production state.

tools.name: upload_artwork
tools.description: Upload a PNG and get an artwork id for create_design, with how large it can print. Pass pngUrl (a public HTTPS link; preferred) or pngBase64, not both. A file on the person's computer: ask them to upload it at https://toolboxpod.com/app/library?tab=artwork, then find it with list_artwork.

tools.name: list_artwork
tools.description: Uploaded artwork, newest first (also files uploaded on the website), each with its artwork id for create_design and its warnings. search matches part of the filename; artworkId gives one file with how large it prints.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Make a NEW design: uploaded artwork placed on the front and/or back of a garment. To show or order a design that already exists, find it with list_designs first; don't create a new design for the same artwork. Ask the person what to call it (title) and list every warning code in acknowledgedWarnings

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: One design: its sides and placement, warnings, whether it is approved for printing and whether production has its print files. withHashes adds its exact print spec and two hashes. The client shows these pictures to the person: refer to each by its label, and never write a preview link as a markdown

tools.name: list_designs
tools.description: The account's designs, newest first, each with its id (for get_mockup and create_order), name, garment, sides and approved (true = can be ordered). query finds one by name. Look here before creating a design: a new design starts unapproved. The client shows these pictures to the person: refer to eac

tools.name: create_estimate
tools.description: A quick nonbinding price for approved designs (design, size, quantity), shipping included. Creates nothing: when the person asks for an order, use create_order instead (drafting is free).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a draft order for one US recipient and get its total (offer.totalCents, shipping included). Drafting is free, so no need to ask first; nothing is charged: tell the person the total and ask before paying (nextStep says how). Leave out storeId (the direct-order store is used) and externalRefere

tools.name: update_order
tools.description: Change the recipient or lines of an order that was never paid (no payment tried). It is quoted again: offer has the new quoteId and total, nextStep how to pay. The lines given replace all the lines.

tools.name: discard_order
tools.description: Throw away an order that was never paid (no payment tried). Cannot be undone.

tools.name: create_support_request
tools.description: Send support a message about an order; you get a reference back. Support replies by email to the person on the account, not here.

tools.name: get_mockup
tools.description: Show a design on a shirt in one color and side, as a picture the client shows to the person: call it by its label. To show an existing design, find it with list_designs first. For a model wearing it, pass look: a model look from list_mockup_looks, in a color it has. Give previews[].url as a plain li

tools.name: list_mockup_looks
tools.description: Our real photo looks for one garment, model shots first, with the colors each has. For "a model wearing it": get_mockup with look set to the model look modelLookFor names for that color. No tool generates a model photo with AI. With designId, the first few show that design. Free. The client shows th

tools.name: generate_design
tools.description: Draw a design with AI. With reference ids (upload_design_reference) it recreates it closely and brief says only what to change; without, brief describes the design (what it shows, exact words, style). Uses 1 of the account's 20 free AI images a month (at most 15 a day); nothing is charged. Then poll

tools.name: get_generation_job
tools.description: An AI design job: its status, versions and nextStep. Judge versions once it is in review: then use_design_version, try_another_version or request_design_changes. When ready, artworkId goes to create_design.

tools.name: use_design_version
tools.description: Chooses this version as the design and makes its print file (free). Once the job is ready, its artworkId goes to create_design.

tools.name: activate_design
tools.description: Approve a design for printing so it can be ordered (its print files go to production). First show the person the design (get_mockup) and ask; call this only after they say yes. Owner or Manager only; free.

tools.name: purchase_order
tools.description: Pay for an order with the account's card: real money. BEFORE calling it, tell the person the total (shipping included) and ask them to confirm; call it only after they say yes, unless they clearly asked to pay right now ("buy it now", "go ahead and pay"). "Order", "make an order" or "order these" al

tools.name: retry_order
tools.description: Try paying for a held order again (an earlier attempt is checked first, so nothing is charged twice). BEFORE calling it, tell the person the total and ask them to confirm, unless they clearly asked to pay for this order right now. Needs an idempotencyKey; a refusal charges nothing.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: A link to the Toolbox POD website where the person, signed in, reviews an order's total and pays for it (a draft, quoted or payment-held order). Changes nothing and charges nothing; only the account Owner can pay there.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "purchase_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Pay for an order with the account's card: real money. BEFORE calling it, tell the person the total (shipping included) and ask them to confirm; call it only aft…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_support_request, get_mockup, get_generation_job, get_checkout_link · Private data: upload_artwork, list_artwork, get_design, use_design_version, activate_design · Public sink: upload_artwork, create_support_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_support_request, get_mockup, get_generation_job, get_checkout_link · Private data: upload_artwork, list_artwork, get_design, use_design_version, activate_design · Public sink: upload_artwork, create_support_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
